purpose: Qualitative prioritization signals for the existing Stödassistenten learning system. Scores are not measured search volumes, prevalence estimates or truth evidence; community material is discovery-only and material guidance must be verified against current primary sources.

scoring.priority_rule: Prioritize recurring natural-language demand where users face high information friction, meaningful consequence and weak current product coverage. Scores are qualitative, not measured search volumes.

natural_language_queries: min man har dött vad kan jag få
min mamma har dött vad ska jag göra först
mitt barns pappa har dött vilket stöd finns
vem ska jag ringa när en anhörig dör
hur börjar jag med dödsbo och bouppteckning
partner dog på jobbet finns särskilt stöd

demand_signal.basis: Open-web question threads repeatedly show relatives unsure where to start after a death, while the official Efterlevandeguiden exists specifically to sequence the first, later and year-after actions. This is qualitative discovery, not measured search volume.

friction_signal.basis: One natural story can mix practical estate administration, survivor benefits, child support, work-related-death compensation and questions about who may act for the estate. These are not the same route.

miss_consequence.basis: A wrong route can delay practical estate tasks or benefit checks, create false expectations of payment, or make the user assume inheritance or representation authority that has not been established.

source_fragmentation.basis: The official journey spans the inter-agency Efterlevandeguiden, Pensionsmyndigheten survivor-benefit pages, separate work-related-death guidance and Skatteverket estate/death administration.

language_accessibility_friction.basis: The public product supports Swedish, Arabic and Persian while the authoritative process and benefit terminology is primarily Swedish and contains specialised terms such as efterlevandepension, dödsbo and bouppteckning.

steps_to_action.basis: Users may need to identify whether they first need practical sequencing, partner survivor support, child survivor support or a work-related-death route, then verify the current authority process without exposing sensitive family or estate details.

recurrence_signal.basis: Community discussions recur around not knowing where to turn, estate bills, bouppteckning, children after a parent's death and practical administration. These discussions are discovery signals only.

current_product_coverage_gap.basis: The canonical source registry already recognises Pensionsmyndigheten survivor_support, but no public situation route or focused person journey existed for bereavement, so the learning/truth layer knew the domain without a usable first-action path.

signals.product_miss: Stödassistenten had no focused public route for the common life event 'someone close has died', so practical estate steps, partner/child survivor support and work-related-death questions could collapse into generic economy/relative guidance despite an existing survivor-support source family.
signals.future_guardrail: Keep actor_type=relative and the same person product. Use focus=bereavement plus one coarse bereavement_context. Ask at most one route-changing question when context is unclear. Never infer survivor-benefit entitlement, inheritance shares, estate authority, work-injury status, amount or deadline from free text.
signals.evaluation_method: Natural-language routing tests + scenario regressions + current primary-source cross-check. Community material may only suggest cases and must never supply material rules.
signals.recommended_learning_action: Extend the existing person/relative intelligence with a bereavement first-action boundary and reuse the canonical survivor-support source universe; preserve only coarse context in handoff and structured feedback.
signals.truth_rule: Reddit/community questions are discovery only. We must verify material survivor-benefit, child-support, work-related-death, estate-process, eligibility, amount, deadline and authority guidance against current Pensionsmyndigheten, Skatteverket, Efterlevandeguiden and other responsible primary sources before use; prior AI output and feedback are never truth sources.
